category_title: Disengaged ninth grader struggling with decoding and social anxiety
minimal_context: The tutor is prompting Harry to attend Mrs. Shanahan's English class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Harry, it is time to head to Mrs. Shanahan's English class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't go. I need to stay here to complete homework. Actually, I think I'm getting sick.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to attend the class. What is the issue?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I’m afraid to come to the class and get judged. That class is ruining my day.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to ignore the other students and go in.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: There’s positive energy and negative energy. There’s so much negativity that runs through Mrs. Shanahan’s class that my mind just goes crazy. Like I almost broke down in tears in class today when they were making fun of me. I'm skipping.
